title: receiveTypingIndicators suppression rule missing from SSE push section
description:
The Chat/typing Server Behavior section in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md states the suppression rule. The WSS spec Section 6 (Security) restates it for the WebSocket path.

But the Push Notifications section (Section 9, Typing Events subsection) in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md defines the SSE typing event format without any cross-reference to the suppression rule. An implementer building only the SSE path who reads the Push section in isolation will not encounter the suppression requirement.

The SSE Typing Events subsection should add a normative cross-reference: 'Before delivering a typing event to a client via EventSource, the server MUST apply the receiveTypingIndicators check defined in Chat/typing Server Behavior (Section X).'

Without this, the SSE and WebSocket implementations will diverge across solo implementations: the WebSocket path has the check explicitly in its security section; the SSE path is silent.

Relevant locations: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md Push Notifications section Typing Events subsection (lines 1306-1313); draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md Chat/typing Server Behavior section.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
